help_content:
Essentialist is a flashcard application that helps you learn and remember information efficiently.

Usage:
- Use the arrow keys to navigate the different sections of the application (Home, Help, Settings).
- In the Home section, you can review your flashcards.
- In the Settings section, you can configure the application to your liking.

Shortcuts:
- Enter: Select or confirm action / See answer
- Esc or q: Go back or cancel / Show home menu
- 1: Score a card as "Again" (Failed)
- 2: Score a card as "Hard"
- 3: Score a card as "Good"
- 4: Score a card as "Easy"
- s or n: Skip card
- p: Go to previous card
- w: Save session
please_set_directory: Please set the directory containing your flashcards.
